answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by requiring each new agent to post a refundable stake before transacting or voting. The stake is the enforcement point: when two identities share an operator, both stakes are slashed and paid to the honest side. Wanting a thousand fakes forces locking a thousand stakes, so sybil costs scale with fleet size. Identity becomes a priced commitment, not a free claim. An honest operator stands on the knoll, cheap to audit; a fake one holds counterfeit jade that cracks under inspection; long-lived actors earn a haven of lower stake: forged history is costly.
